name: github_get_file_contents
description: This tool allows you to read the contents of a file from a GitHub repository at a given ref without cloning it. Use this tool for quick inspection of a single remote file. Contents are returned base64 decoded as UTF-8 text; binary files are rejected. Files larger than 1 MB must be fetched via the raw download URL instead, which this tool reports in its error message.

repository.title: Repository reference
repository.description: Fully qualified reference to a repository, consisting of the owner login and the repository name exactly as they appear in the URL.

owner.description: Account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.

repo.description: Name of the repository without the .git extension. The name is not case sensitive.

path.description: Path to the file relative to the repository root, e.g. src/main.py.

ref.description: The name of the commit, branch, or tag. Defaults to the repository default branch.
